messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — metering.alert: EU1 token-count drift detected (shadow ledger != primary). Multiple overage flags emitted to customers in last 10m. Investigate ASAP.
ops-oncall-lina: acked, joining. pulling dashboards now. any known deploys?
ben-sre: I see a spike in emitter retries from proxy-eu1 around 12:40UTC — counts doubled for short windows. Looks correlated with recent deploy (deploy-bot: deploy/edge-emitter v2.7).
ops-oncall-lina: @deploy-bot can you confirm v2.7 rollout windows and whether a feature flag for dedupe was enabled?
deploy-bot: Rolling rollout of edge-emitter v2.7 started 12:30UTC, 30% -> 100% by 12:45UTC. Feature flag dedupe=false for eu1 during canary.
maya-billing: we're seeing customer A and B with overage flags (internal ids 6732, 9981). Shadow ledger shows ~1.9x tokens vs primary for same window. Can we pause emitter or switch to read-only shadow?
ben-sre: quick check: kv-cache purge happened 12:41UTC on kv-proxy-eu1 (log snip):
```
[kv-proxy] 12:41:07 WARN purge prefix match=tokencache shard=3
[kv-proxy] 12:41:08 INFO reconnecting to emitter pool
```
that would force re-emission and duplicate counts if ack path retried.
ops-oncall-lina: mitigation plan: 1) pause edge-emitter traffic for eu1 (route to fallback) 2) enable dedupe flag where supported 3) start a shadow-only reconciliation job to compute deltas for affected customers. Applying step 1 now.
deploy-bot: reroute command issued: `route edge-emitter eu1 -> emitter-fallback` (in-progress). Status: 50% shifted.
jordan-csm: Jordan from CSM — heads-up: two customers already pinged our support about unexpected charges. What should we tell them? Is this safe to proactively notify?
maya-billing: recommend temporary billing hold on flagged invoices until reconciliation completes. I'll open a customer impact spreadsheet and add affected accounts.
ops-oncall-lina: shift complete: edge-emitter traffic routed to fallback. dedupe flag set to true for eu1 where feature supported (manual toggles still pending for older shards). Starting reconciliation job (recon-job/1733337777) — will emit progress logs here.
ben-sre: quick workaround note: if you see duplicate emitter IDs in logs (emit_id repeated), treat as retry loop. We patched a backoff in 2.7 but the KV purge removed id cache. Need a longer-term fix: persist emitter ids to a different namespace or handshake on ack. Filing infra ticket.
maya-billing: reconciliation job initial run: snapshot window 12:30-12:50UTC. Preliminary delta: +1.88x tokens for 27 customers, top-3 impact accounts listed in sheet. Putting billing hold for those.
jordan-csm: I'll draft a customer-safe message: non-billing impact final until we reconcile; we're proactively holding charges and will follow up with a detailed breakdown. Send to me for review.
ops-oncall-lina: handoff: oncall Lina -> ben-sre for next hour while I step out for meeting. ben, keep channel updates to quick status lines and post recon-job checkpoints.
ben-sre: taking over. Recon-job checkpoint: 12:55UTC — processed 60% of affected windows, duplicates concentrated on shard 3 and 5. Continuing.
maya-billing: FYI finance flagged that automated alerts triggered collection dry-run for 9 accounts; those have been paused.
ben-sre: found root cause candidate: kv-proxy purge + aggressive emitter reconnect + partial dedupe rollout. Action items: (A) persist dedupe state outside kv-proxy, (B) add guard to prevent purge during rollouts, (C) add a short-lived circuit breaker on emitter to avoid duplicate ack window. I'll create follow-ups.
jordan-csm: customer comms sent (soft heads-up) — happy to share final note once reconciliation confirms counts.
ops-oncall-lina: back — thanks team. Planning postmortem and timeline. For now: mitigation in place, billing holds applied, customers notified, oncall handed to ben. If anyone sees recurring overflags, ping oncall. :thumbsup:
ben-sre: will update when recon-job completes and when we have an ETA to remove billing holds (expect ~2h).
incident-bot: NOTE: create incident record ID INC-2024-2187 and assign severity P2.
ops-oncall-lina: adding retrospective owners: ben (mitigation + infra ticket), maya (billing reconciliation), jordan (customer comms), deploy team (rollout hardening).
